text:
Now I am very puzzled and hope for an explanation:

My wife is here with a B1 visa.

This includes a working permit.

Today she was at a kindergarden, where they wanted to employ her, but then they said, they can't do this if she does no have a T.Z.

Of course she does not, she only has a B1 (in her passport).

I don't understand: B1 visa clearly says, that you are allowed to work. But now this!

What's the situation?
